title: Savings & Copay Assistance Programs — Membership Fee and Term Schedule
content:
Membership fees, terms and renewal settings of each program type of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs, as the Savings Programs office publishes them.

| Setting | Kestrel Rx Discount Card | Kestrel Rx Savings Club Individual | Kestrel Rx Savings Club Family | Manufacturer Copay Card | Manufacturer Bridge Program | Charitable Foundation Copay Grant |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Enrollment fee | $0.00 | $20.00 | $35.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Has an expiration date | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Membership term (calendar months) | 0 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 6 | 12 |
| Renews itself at expiration | No | Yes | Yes | No | No | No |
| Fee refund window (calendar days after the fee is charged) | 0 | 30 | 30 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Fee refunded only if no discounted fill used the program since the charge | No | Yes | Yes | No | No | No |
| Renewal or re-application lead (calendar days before expiration) | 0 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 0 | 30 |
| Renewal grace after a failed auto-renewal fee (calendar days) | 0 | 15 | 15 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| May enroll again after the program expires | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | Yes |

## Reading the schedule

- **Enrollment fee** — the program's membership fee in US dollars, the fee a paid membership charges when it is activated. The Kestrel Rx Discount Card and the manufacturer and foundation programs carry a fee of $0.00.
- **Expiration and term** — where a program has an expiration date, its term is the number of calendar months from activation (or, at renewal, from the previous expiration) to the expiration date. A program with no expiration date shows a term of 0 months.
- **Renews itself** — whether the program renews at expiration and charges the fee again. Only the two Kestrel Rx Savings Club memberships renew themselves.
- **Fee refund window** — the number of calendar days after a fee is charged within which that fee may be refunded; the adjacent row states whether a refund also requires that no discounted fill used the program since the fee was charged.
- **Renewal or re-application lead** — the number of calendar days before the expiration date from which renewal or re-application may be done.
- **Renewal grace** — the number of calendar days after an auto-renewal fee fails during which program prices are still honored.
- **May enroll again** — whether the patient may enroll in the same program again after it expires. The Manufacturer Bridge Program is the only program type marked No.

## Points of comparison

| Question the schedule answers | Answer from the table |
|---|---|
| Which program types charge a fee at all? | Kestrel Rx Savings Club Individual at $20.00 and Kestrel Rx Savings Club Family at $35.00 |
| Which program type has the shortest term? | Manufacturer Bridge Program, 6 months |
| Which program types have a 12-month term? | Both club memberships, the Manufacturer Copay Card and the Charitable Foundation Copay Grant |
| Which program type never expires? | Kestrel Rx Discount Card (term 0, no expiration date) |
| Which program types allow renewal or re-application 30 days ahead? | Both club memberships, the Manufacturer Copay Card and the Charitable Foundation Copay Grant |
